maya_sales: Heads-up 1: Acme's POC upload failed during the demo. They tried sending a generated PDF (with inlined base64 images) and got a 413.
acme_poc_engineer: repro: our CMS POSTs the PDF to /v1/generate as application/pdf. File is ~9.6MB (tool reports) but our client showed 10.2MB on the wire. We hit `413 Request Entity Too Large`.
acme_poc_engineer: curl used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Content-Type: application/pdf" --data-binary @report.pdf```
caleb_se: likely byte vs reported size mismatch from CRLF conversion or a BOM. Any chance the client added Content-Encoding: gzip or chunked?
acme_poc_engineer: no gzip. We generate PDF via headless chrome, then base64-inline images; no chunked. The client is Java-based, maybe uploads via HttpUrlConnection.
rana_sre: our gateway default max_body_bytes is 8,388,608 (8MB) for hosted routes. If the file is 9.6-10.2MB on the wire that's the cause. We can create a per-account route override for the demo.
ingrid_eng: logs show `ingress_bytes`=10234567 and `route`=`acct-acme-demo`. Also saw `transfer_encoding` header absent; backend accepted until gateway aborted. Notably the request lacked a Content-Length header so some proxies switched to chunked, which inflates on-the-wire size slightly.
zoe_devex: quick client-side fixes we can recommend: 1) re-generate PDF without inlined base64 images (serve images separately) 2) compress PDF (many images are uncompressed PNGs) 3) upload to S3 presigned and send URL to the API (we support fetching). Example for presign process in curl: ```curl -X PUT "https://s3...presign" -H "Content-Type: application/pdf" --upload-file report.pdf```
caleb_se: for tomorrow's demo I'm +1 on a short-lived route increase. Rana can you do a 16MB temporary bump for `acct-acme-demo`?
rana_sre: can do 16,777,216 bytes (16MB) for 24h. Scheduling change now.
infra-bot: API Gateway change queued: route `acct-acme-demo` max_body_bytes -> 16777216. change_id=chg-4812
ingrid_eng: I added a heuristic alert to flag requests with missing Content-Length and Content-Type application/pdf + size >6MB so ops can contact customers proactively. Also opened an item for model-onboarding docs to recommend presigned uploads for large artifacts.
zoe_devex: I'll DM Acme with a presign flow + a one-liner to strip BOMs and ensure Content-Length is set in Java: ```byte[] b = Files.readAllBytes(path); HttpURLConnection con = (HttpURLConnection)url.openConnection(); con.setFixedLengthStreamingMode(b.length);```
maya_sales: plan: Rana apply bump, Zoe share presign+strip-BOM guide, Caleb run demo retest. Acme, can you retest after change is live?
acme_poc_engineer: thanks 1: will try retest once bump is live and report back in this thread.
